basis_field: customer.datecreated (NetSuite) -> TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY'), banded. NO field in NetSuite carries the original Sage acquisition date: all 108 ENTITY-type custom fields checked (none is a legacy/original/Sage date); firstorderdate, firstsaledate, startdate, firstvisit, dateclosed, datelead, dateprospect, dateconversion are all 2023+ on migrated accounts (one record has firstorderdate 2002); comments never mention 'since'/'sage'; the transaction table has no pre-go-live history (12 revenue-type transactions dated 2023, 5,481 in 2024, none earlier).
category_mapping: BUILTIN.DF(customer.category) 2026-09-05: 2 = Garage Experts (excluded), 3 = DIY, 4 = Contractor, 7 = CA Will Call (kept), 14 = Vendor (excluded)
coverage_note: datecreated is a MIGRATION date for legacy accounts. Of 3,043 Customers (sub 2, stage CUSTOMER%, firstorderdate not null, excl cat 2/14): 823 show datecreated 2023 (loads on 2023-08-21: 610, 09-27: 3, 10-13: 1, 10-30: 209; Sage account numbers 22..10694) and a further 235 were loaded 2024-09-10/27/29/30 before the Oct-2024 go-live; only 256 of the 491 '2024' accounts were genuinely created in 2024. Consequently the 2007-2009 .. 2020-2021 bands are EMPTY under this basis, the 2022-2023 band is entirely migration-dated legacy accounts (683 active in FY2025) and the 2024 band mixes ~235 loaded legacy accounts with genuine post-go-live accounts. v1 (Aug 18 2026) used Sage created dates from a source outside NetSuite that is not in this repository; its pre-2018 / 2010-2012 figures cannot be reproduced from NetSuite. Genuine eras are reliable for 2025 and 2026 only.
definition: For each account (customer.id) with at least one NET-positive transaction in the window: era = TO_CHAR(customer.datecreated,'YYYY') banded 2007-2009/2010-2012/2013-2015/2016-2017/2018-2019/2020-2021/2022-2023/2024/2025/2026; net_revenue = the canonical NET join from net_revenue_monthly.sql (t.type IN CustInvc/CashSale/CustCred/CustRfnd, t.subsidiary=2, tl.mainline='F', tl.taxline='F', tl.item NOT NULL, i.itemtype NOT NULL, c.category NOT IN (2,14), SUM(-tl.foreignamount), COALESCE) summed over the window for those accounts; revenue_per_account = net_revenue/accounts; shares are of the window totals. Query src/data/queries/acquisition_vintage.sql, run per datecreated-year slice (<2024, 2024, 2025, >=2026) per window; 8 calls, 29 rows, 2026-09-05. Accounts whose datecreated is 2026 yet have 2025 revenue (9 in FY2025) are record re-creations/merges and are kept under their datecreated year.

fy2025.active_definition: account has >= 1 transaction with NET > 0 in the window (pos_txns > 0); revenue is those accounts' full window NET incl. their credits

population_note: Active = any NET-positive transaction in the window, subsidiary 2 (t.subsidiary), category NOT IN (2,14); no stage/firstorderdate filter (2 of 2,047 accounts transacting in 2025 are stage LEAD). Cross-checks 2026-09-05 for 2025: distinct accounts on any revenue-type transaction 2,047; on any product line 2,047; with a SalesOrd 2,093; no account has freight-only lines. NetSuite yields ~2,040-2,090 accounts under every reading, so the published 2,676 active accounts is not reproducible from NetSuite and probably came from the same external Sage-based source (or was not de-duplicated).
